name: managehomestay
description: Manage Homestay – short-stay and long-term rental management (Cloudflare Workers)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c blue,green "pnpm -F server dev" "pnpm -F client dev"
scripts.build: pnpm -F @rentlite/shared build && pnpm -F client build && pnpm -F server build
scripts.check: pnpm -F @rentlite/shared check && pnpm -F server check && pnpm -F client check
